name: A Survey for Graphic Design Intelligence
description: Surveys computational methods for understanding and generating graphic design artifacts (2023).

name: From Fragment to One Piece: A Survey on AI-Driven Graphic Design
description: Reviews AI-driven graphic-design generation across layout, visual content, text, and integrated systems (2025).

name: Intelligent Layout Generation Based on Deep Generative Models: A Comprehensive Survey
description: Reviews deep generative approaches to layout generation, their representations, conditions, datasets, and evaluation (Information Fusion 2023).

name: CanvasVAE
description: Uses a variational autoencoder to model element-level layouts for design documents (ICCV 2021).

name: Coarse-to-Fine
description: Generates layouts hierarchically from coarse global structure to fine element placement (AAAI 2022).

name: DeepLayout
description: Models layouts autoregressively as sequences for conditional and unconditional generation (ICCV 2021).

name: DLT
description: Applies diffusion modeling to structured layout generation (ICCV 2023).

name: Dolfin
description: Uses a diffusion layout transformer without an autoencoder for structured layout generation (ECCV 2024).

name: FlexDM
description: Supports flexible layout generation and completion through masked multi-field diffusion (CVPR 2023).

name: i-Design
description: Optimizes graphic layout design step by step with progressive aesthetic policy optimization (ECCV 2026).
date_note: ECCV 2026 conference start; no arXiv located

name: LACE
description: Introduces lightweight diffusion for controllable layout generation (ICLR 2024).

name: Layout-BLT
description: Uses bidirectional layout transformers to generate and refine object arrangements (ECCV 2022).

name: Layout-Corrector
description: Corrects intermediate diffusion layouts to improve structure and constraint satisfaction (ECCV 2024).

name: LayoutAction
description: Frames autoregressive layout generation as a sequence of placement actions (AAAI 2023).

name: LayoutDiffusion
description: Uses discrete diffusion for controllable layout generation (ICCV 2023).

name: LayoutDM
description: Models layouts with discrete denoising diffusion and supports multiple conditional generation tasks (CVPR 2023).

name: LayoutFlow
description: Uses flow matching for continuous structured layout generation (ECCV 2024).

name: LayoutFormer++
description: Treats layout generation as a sequence-to-sequence task with unified conditioning (CVPR 2023).

name: LayoutGAN
description: Introduces a GAN formulation for synthesizing layouts represented by labeled geometric elements (ICLR 2019).

name: LayoutGAN++
description: Improves GAN-based layout generation with differentiable rendering and stronger geometric reasoning (ACM MM 2021).

name: LayoutGPT
description: Uses large language models with in-context demonstrations for layout generation (NeurIPS 2023).

name: LayoutNUWA
description: Represents visual layouts as code for language-model-based generation and reasoning (ICLR 2024).

name: LayoutPrompter
description: Prompts large language models for zero-shot and few-shot visual layout generation (NeurIPS 2023).

name: LayoutVAE
description: Uses a label-conditioned variational autoencoder for structured document layout generation (ICCV 2019).

name: LDGM
description: Decouples discrete element attributes and continuous geometry in a diffusion model for unified layout generation (CVPR 2023).

name: Learning Layouts for Single-Page Graphic Designs
description: Learns layout relationships from existing single-page graphic designs to support automatic composition (TVCG 2014).

name: Neural Design Network
description: Generates graphic layouts under explicit design constraints with a neural structured model (ECCV 2020).

name: Parse-Then-Place
description: Parses textual design descriptions into structured constraints before placing graphic elements (ICCV 2023).

name: PLay
description: Uses parametrically conditioned latent diffusion for controllable layout generation (ICML 2023).

name: PosterO
description: Structures layouts as trees so language models can solve generalized layout-generation tasks (CVPR 2025).

name: TextLap
description: Generates graphic layouts from textual design requirements with language-model-based reasoning.

name: CGB-DM
description: Uses a diffusion transformer for graphic-layout generation with content-aware conditioning.

name: CGL-GAN
description: Generates advertising layouts conditioned on visual content and introduces the CGL dataset (IJCAI 2022).

name: ContentGAN
description: Generates graphic-design layouts conditioned on underlying visual content (SIGGRAPH 2019).

name: CreatiPoster
description: Generates poster layouts from multimodal content and design requirements.

name: Design Element Aware Poster Layout Generation
description: Models poster design elements and their relationships for content-aware poster layout generation (CIKM 2024).
date_note: CIKM 2024 conference start; no arXiv located

name: Graphist
description: Models graphic-design layouts with multimodal and structural context.

name: ICVT
description: Generates layouts conditioned on image content with geometry-aligned variational transformers (ACM MM 2022).

name: iPoster
description: Supports interactive content-aware poster layout generation under flexible user-specified constraints (CHI EA 2026).

name: LayoutDETR
description: Generates foreground layouts conditioned on content images for advertising design (ECCV 2024).

name: Learning Priority-Aware Controllable Poster Layout Generation
description: Uses LLM- and vision-derived priorities, optimal-transport matching, and flow-based refinement for controllable poster layout generation (Pattern Recognition 2026).

name: PosterLayout
description: Introduces a benchmark and content-aware approach for visual-textual poster layout generation (CVPR 2023).

name: PosterLLaMA
description: Adapts a multimodal language model to poster layout generation (ECCV 2024).

name: PosterLLaVA
description: Uses multimodal instruction tuning for poster layout generation (IEEE TMM 2024).

name: RADM
description: Generates content-aware advertising layouts with richer text and visual conditioning (CIKM 2023).

name: RALF
description: Retrieves relevant design examples to guide content-aware layout generation (CVPR 2024).

name: Scan-and-Print
description: Uses patch-level image summarization and data augmentation for efficient content-aware poster layout generation (IJCAI 2025).

name: SEGA
description: Uses stepwise evolution for content-aware poster layout generation and introduces GenPoster-100K (ICCV 2025).

name: SmartText
description: Places text over natural images using saliency and learned aesthetic compatibility for harmonious poster composition (TMM 2021).

name: Two-stage Content-Aware Layout Generation for Poster Designs
description: Combines aesthetics-conditioned diffusion layout proposals with a learned ranking stage for poster designs over image backgrounds (ACM MM 2023).
date_note: ACM proceedings publication precedes conference start on 2023-10-29

name: Uni-Layout
description: Unifies multiple layout-generation conditions with human-feedback-based evaluation and preference alignment (ACM MM 2025).

name: Visual Layout Composer
description: Couples image-space and vector-space diffusion to generate design layouts conditioned on visual content (CVPR 2024).

name: AutoPoster
description: Integrates content analysis and layout generation into an automatic advertising-poster design system (2023).

name: AutoPP
description: Automates product-poster generation and CTR-oriented optimization using unified design generation and online-feedback preference learning (AAAI 2026).

name: BannerAgency
description: Uses collaborating multimodal LLM agents to plan and generate advertising banner designs from brand assets and requests (2025).

name: Brief2Design
description: Supports prompt-based professional graphic design through requirement extraction, element exploration, and compositional recombination.

name: COLE
description: Uses a hierarchical generation framework to create multi-layered, editable graphic designs from high-level intent (2023).

name: CreatiDesign
description: Uses a multi-conditional diffusion transformer to compose primary visuals, decorative elements, text, and layout for graphic design.

name: Desigen
description: Jointly generates advertising backgrounds and foreground element layouts (CVPR 2024).

name: Design Your Ad
description: Jointly generates personalized advertising images and text from multimodal user histories with a unified autoregressive model and introduces PAd1M and PBS (CVPR 2026).

name: DesignAsCode
description: Represents graphic designs as HTML/CSS and iteratively plans, implements, and visually refines editable designs (ACM MM 2026).

name: Designer-RSI
description: Adapts a tool-using graphic-design agent through continually refined procedural memory learned from real user briefs.

name: Human-aware Design Generation

name: InnoAds-Composer

name: InterIL

name: LaDeCo

name: OpenCOLE

name: POSTA

name: PosterVerse

name: PSDesigner
description: Automates layered graphic-design workflows with editable PSD structure and tool-use trajectories (CVPR 2026).

name: RefAdGen

name: SIMPLEPOSTER
description: Generates product posters with faithful subject preservation and position-controllable text rendering (CVPR 2026).

name: Towards Reliable Advertising Image Generation Using Human Feedback
description: Uses a learned reliable-feedback network, recurrent generation, and feedback-guided diffusion fine-tuning to improve usable e-commerce advertising images (ECCV 2024).

name: ART
description: Generates variable numbers of transparent image layers from a global prompt and anonymous region layout using an Anonymous Region Transformer (CVPR 2025).

name: LayerDiffuse

name: LayerFusion
description: Generates harmonized foreground RGBA, background RGB, and composite images jointly using pretrained generative priors (CVPR Findings 2026).

name: MRT
description: Unifies text-to-layers, image-to-layers, and layer-to-layer editing in a 20B masked-region diffusion model for scalable RGBA asset generation (CVPR 2026).

name: PrismLayers
description: Introduces PrismLayers and PrismLayersPro plus ART+ for high-quality multi-layer transparent image generation from text and layouts.

name: Qwen-Image-Layered
description: Decomposes raster images into variable-length semantically separated RGBA layers for independently editable visual assets (CVPR 2026).

name: SAWNA

name: TAUE
description: Generates coherent foreground, background, and composite layers without fine-tuning by transplanting and cultivating intermediate diffusion noise representations (CVPR Findings 2026).

name: TKG-DM

name: PosterMaker

name: TextDiffuser-2

name: TextPainter

name: PosterCopilot

description: Recovers editable layer hierarchies, typography, geometry, colors, and grouping from raster design images (ECCV 2026).
